chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Saeed, from Abu Ubeyda al-Hadda', from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever says, 'I testify that there is no god except Allah, Alone, with no partner for Him, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger,' Allah writes for him a thousand thousand (million) good deeds.

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god except Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting the Shahada according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (as) underscores the transformative power of the Shahada, linking the declaration of Tawhid and Nubuwwah directly to divine merit. The specific reward of 'one million good deeds' highlights the foundational status of this testimony in Shia jurisprudence and spirituality, serving as a gateway to all other acts of worship.
